description: Set up a donor management system from data model through segmentation to acknowledgment workflows.

steps.description: Define donor data fields including contact information, giving history, communication preferences, and relationships.

inputs.name: organization-profile
inputs.desc: Description of the nonprofit and its donor base

inputs.name: existing-data-sources
inputs.desc: Current systems and spreadsheets holding donor data

outputs.name: donor-data-model
outputs.desc: Field definitions for the donor record

outputs.name: data-migration-map
outputs.desc: Mapping from existing sources to the new model

process: List every field needed for donor records (name, address, email, phone, employer, relationships)
Define giving history fields (gift date, amount, campaign, fund, payment method)
Add communication preference and opt-in fields
Map existing data sources to the new field structure

steps.description: Select the CRM or database platform for donor management based on requirements and budget.

inputs.name: donor-data-model
inputs.desc: Field definitions for the donor record

process: List must-have features (gift tracking, reporting, email integration, receipting)
Evaluate three or more platforms against the requirements
Compare pricing including implementation and training costs
Recommend the best fit with justification

steps.description: Import existing donor records into the new system with validation and deduplication.

inputs.name: data-migration-map
inputs.desc: Mapping from existing sources to the new model

outputs.name: import-report
outputs.desc: Summary of records imported, skipped, and flagged

process: Extract data from all existing sources
Clean and standardize records (address formatting, name parsing)
Deduplicate using matching rules (name, email, address)
Import into the selected system and verify record counts

steps.description: Segment donors by giving level, recency, frequency, and engagement for targeted communications.

inputs.name: organization-profile
inputs.desc: Description of the nonprofit and its programs

process: Define giving level tiers (major, mid-level, annual, first-time, lapsed)
Apply RFM analysis (recency, frequency, monetary value)
Create engagement segments (event attendees, volunteers, board members)
Assign every donor to at least one segment

steps.description: Set up automated acknowledgment and receipting workflows for gifts.

outputs.name: acknowledgment-templates
outputs.desc: Templates for thank-you letters and tax receipts by segment

outputs.name: acknowledgment-plan
outputs.desc: Workflow rules for timing and channel of acknowledgments

process: Define acknowledgment timing targets (48 hours for gifts, same day for major gifts)
Create templates by segment (personal letter for major donors, email for online gifts)
Set up tax receipt generation with required IRS language
Configure the automated workflow in the CRM

steps.description: Produce the donor management plan summarizing the system, segments, and workflows.

outputs.name: training-guide
outputs.desc: Staff guide for using the donor system

process: Summarize the data model and system selection rationale
Document each segment and its communication strategy
Describe the acknowledgment workflows and timing standards
Write the staff training guide for daily operations

description: Plan a fundraising campaign from goal setting through channel selection to tracking and reporting.

steps.description: Set the fundraising campaign goal, timeline, and success metrics.
process: Review past campaign results and donor capacity
Set a dollar goal grounded in historical performance and growth targets
Define the campaign timeline with key milestones
Select KPIs (total raised, donor count, average gift, retention rate)

steps.description: Segment the donor audience for targeted campaign messaging.
process: Identify segments relevant to this campaign (lapsed, current, prospects, major)
Estimate giving capacity per segment
Build contact lists with preferred communication channels
Prioritize segments by expected return on effort

steps.description: Select and plan the communication channels for the campaign.
process: Evaluate channels (direct mail, email, social media, phone, events, peer-to-peer)
Match channels to audience segments
Allocate budget across channels based on expected ROI
Plan the message sequence per channel

steps.description: Create the case for support that tells the story and makes the ask.
process: Define the need with data and a human story
Describe the solution and the organization's track record
State the specific ask and what a gift will accomplish
Adapt the message for each segment

steps.description: Build the campaign calendar with touchpoints, deadlines, and milestones.

outputs.name: production-deadlines
outputs.desc: Deadlines for creative and print production

process: Plot the launch, mid-campaign push, and close dates
Schedule each touchpoint by channel
Set production deadlines working backward from send dates
Add milestone check-ins for progress review

steps.description: Set up tracking and reporting for campaign progress.
process: Configure the CRM to track gifts by campaign code
Set up the reporting dashboard with KPIs
Define the reporting cadence (daily during active pushes, weekly otherwise)
Compile everything into the campaign plan document

description: Write a grant proposal from funder research through budget narrative to final submission.

steps.description: Research the funder's priorities, requirements, and past grants.

inputs.name: project-summary
inputs.desc: Brief description of the project to be funded

outputs.name: funder-profile
outputs.desc: Funder priorities, eligibility, and past awards

outputs.name: alignment-assessment
outputs.desc: How the project aligns with funder priorities

process: Review the funder's mission, strategic priorities, and funding guidelines
Analyze past grants (amounts, recipients, geographic focus)
Assess alignment between the project and funder priorities
Note application requirements, deadlines, and restrictions

steps.description: Draft the needs statement grounded in data and community voice.
process: Define the problem with quantitative data (prevalence, trends, disparities)
Include the community perspective and lived experience
Frame the need in terms that match the funder's priorities
Keep the statement focused and free of jargon

steps.description: Describe the program design, logic model, and implementation plan.

outputs.name: program-narrative
outputs.desc: Description of the program and its theory of change

process: Describe the program activities and how they address the need
Build the logic model linking inputs to outcomes
Include the implementation timeline with milestones
Explain the staffing plan and key personnel qualifications

steps.description: Write the evaluation plan with indicators, data collection, and analysis methods.

outputs.name: data-collection-tools
outputs.desc: Instruments and schedules for data collection

process: Define process and outcome evaluation questions
Select indicators for each outcome in the logic model
Describe data collection methods, frequency, and responsible staff
Explain the analysis approach and how results will inform the program

steps.description: Prepare the grant budget and budget narrative.

inputs.name: program-narrative
inputs.desc: Program description with staffing and activities

process: List all costs by category (personnel, fringe, travel, supplies, contractual, indirect)
Calculate each line item with supporting assumptions
Apply the funder's indirect cost rate or negotiate
Write the budget narrative explaining each line

steps.description: Compile all sections and attachments into the final grant proposal.

outputs.name: submission-checklist
outputs.desc: Verified list of all required components

process: Assemble sections in the funder's required order
Write the executive summary and cover letter
Compile required attachments (board list, financials, letters of support)
Review for compliance with page limits, formatting, and submission instructions

description: Manage volunteers from recruitment through scheduling to recognition.

steps.description: Recruit volunteers through targeted outreach channels.

inputs.name: volunteer-needs
inputs.desc: Roles, skills, and time commitments needed

inputs.name: organization-profile
inputs.desc: Description of the organization and its mission

outputs.name: recruitment-plan
outputs.desc: Channels and messaging for volunteer recruitment

process: Define each volunteer role with required skills and time commitment
Select recruitment channels (website, social media, volunteer match sites, community partners)
Create recruitment messaging that communicates the impact of volunteering
Track applications and inquiries

steps.description: Screen and onboard new volunteers with orientation and training.
process: Screen applicants (background checks where required, reference checks)
Conduct orientation covering mission, policies, and expectations
Provide role-specific training
Collect signed agreements and emergency contact information

steps.description: Assign roles and schedule shifts based on skills and availability.

inputs.name: volunteer-needs
inputs.desc: Roles and time slots to fill

outputs.name: volunteer-schedule
outputs.desc: Shift assignments by date and role

process: Match volunteers to roles based on skills and preferences
Collect availability and scheduling constraints
Build the schedule and confirm assignments
Identify and flag coverage gaps for additional recruitment

steps.description: Track volunteer hours, contributions, and attendance.

outputs.name: hours-log
outputs.desc: Tracked hours by volunteer and role

process: Set up the time tracking system (sign-in sheets, app, or CRM)
Record hours for each shift
Flag no-shows and chronic absences
Generate monthly summaries for reporting and recognition

steps.description: Recognize and retain volunteers through appreciation programs.
process: Define recognition tiers based on hours and impact
Plan recognition events and communications (thank-you letters, awards, social media features)
Survey volunteers for satisfaction and feedback
Compile the volunteer management report with metrics and recommendations

description: Produce an impact report from outcome definition through data collection to stakeholder distribution.

steps.description: Define the outcomes and indicators to measure for the impact report.

inputs.name: program-description
inputs.desc: Description of the program or initiative

outputs.name: data-collection-plan
outputs.desc: What data to collect and how

process: List the intended outcomes of the program
Define one or more measurable indicators per outcome
Specify data sources, collection methods, and responsible staff
Set targets or benchmarks for each indicator

steps.description: Collect and compile quantitative output and outcome data.

outputs.name: data-quality-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on data completeness and limitations

process: Pull data from program databases, surveys, and administrative records
Calculate values for each indicator
Check for data quality issues (missing data, outliers)
Document any limitations or caveats

steps.description: Gather qualitative data including stories, testimonials, and case studies.

outputs.name: consent-records
outputs.desc: Permissions for use of personal stories

process: Identify participants willing to share their stories
Conduct interviews or collect written testimonials
Select the most illustrative examples for each outcome
Obtain written consent for publication

steps.description: Analyze results against targets and write the findings narrative.
process: Compare each indicator to its target or benchmark
Identify trends, successes, and areas for improvement
Integrate qualitative examples to illustrate the numbers
Write the narrative connecting activities to outcomes

steps.description: Design and produce the impact report for stakeholder distribution.

outputs.name: distribution-plan
outputs.desc: Who receives the report and how

process: Design the report layout with charts, photos, and infographics
Include the executive summary, detailed findings, and financial overview
Plan distribution by audience (donors, board, public, funders)
Prepare print and digital versions

description: Set up nonprofit board governance from role definition through orientation to engagement tracking.

steps.description: Define board roles, responsibilities, and expectations.

inputs.name: organization-bylaws
inputs.desc: Current bylaws and articles of incorporation

outputs.name: role-descriptions
outputs.desc: Written descriptions for each board position

outputs.name: expectations-document
outputs.desc: Board member agreement covering duties and time commitment

process: Define fiduciary duties (duty of care, loyalty, obedience)
Write role descriptions for officers and at-large members
Set expectations for attendance, giving, and committee service
Draft the board member agreement for signature

steps.description: Recruit board members to fill skill and perspective gaps.

inputs.name: current-board-roster
inputs.desc: Existing board members and their skills

outputs.name: skills-gap-matrix
outputs.desc: Skills needed vs. skills on the current board

outputs.name: prospect-list
outputs.desc: Candidates to recruit with approach strategy

process: Map current board skills (finance, legal, marketing, fundraising, program expertise)
Identify gaps in skills, demographics, and community connections
Build a prospect list with cultivation approach for each
Prioritize recruitment based on the most pressing gaps

steps.description: Establish the committee structure with charters and assignments.
process: Define standing committees (executive, finance, governance, fundraising, program)
Write a charter for each committee (purpose, membership, meeting frequency)
Assign board members to committees based on skills
Set the committee reporting schedule to the full board

steps.description: Set the meeting cadence, agenda framework, and decision-making process.

outputs.name: meeting-calendar
outputs.desc: Annual calendar of board and committee meetings

process: Set the board meeting frequency (monthly, bimonthly, quarterly)
Design the standard agenda (consent agenda, committee reports, discussion items, action items)
Define the decision-making process (quorum, voting, consent agenda)
Build the annual calendar with all board and committee meetings

steps.description: Build the board orientation program for new members.

outputs.name: orientation-materials
outputs.desc: Board binder with all governance documents

process: Compile the board binder (bylaws, financials, strategic plan, roster, calendar)
Design the orientation session (mission overview, fiduciary duties, key programs)
Schedule meetings with the executive director and committee chairs
Set up the mentor pairing for each new member

steps.description: Track board member engagement and produce the governance handbook.
process: Track attendance at board and committee meetings
Monitor giving and fundraising participation
Conduct annual board self-assessment
Compile the governance handbook with all policies and procedures

description: Run an annual fund drive from target setting through multi-channel outreach to reporting.

steps.description: Set the annual fund target based on budget needs and donor capacity.

inputs.name: donor-history
inputs.desc: Past giving data and donor retention rates

outputs.name: fund-target
outputs.desc: Dollar goal with breakdown by segment

outputs.name: retention-upgrade-goals
outputs.desc: Targets for donor retention and upgrade rates

process: Calculate the gap between budget and other revenue sources
Set the overall dollar target
Break the target down by donor segment (renew, upgrade, acquire, recapture)
Set retention and upgrade rate goals

steps.description: Segment the prospect list for personalized outreach.
process: Segment by giving level and recency
Calculate a suggested ask amount for each donor (based on last gift and capacity)
Flag lapsed donors for re-engagement messaging
Identify acquisition prospects from non-donor contacts

steps.description: Personalize the appeal messaging by segment.

outputs.name: channel-assignments
outputs.desc: Delivery channel per donor (mail, email, phone, in-person)

process: Write the core appeal story
Adapt the message for each segment (first-time, renewal, upgrade, lapsed)
Personalize the ask amount and impact statement
Assign each donor to the most effective channel

steps.description: Execute the multi-channel outreach campaign.
process: Send direct mail appeals on the scheduled date
Deploy email campaigns with follow-up sequences
Execute phone-a-thon for targeted segments
Track responses and gifts as they arrive

steps.description: Track results and produce the annual fund report.

outputs.name: donor-acknowledgment-list
outputs.desc: Donors to thank with gift details

process: Calculate total raised vs. goal by segment
Compute retention, upgrade, and acquisition rates
Identify what worked and what to adjust next year
Produce the report and the acknowledgment list

description: Set up a planned giving program from vehicle identification through prospect cultivation to pipeline tracking.

steps.description: Identify the planned giving vehicles to offer based on organizational capacity.

outputs.name: vehicle-menu
outputs.desc: Planned giving options to market (bequests, trusts, annuities, beneficiary designations)

outputs.name: administration-plan
outputs.desc: How each vehicle will be administered

process: Review planned giving vehicles (bequests, charitable remainder trusts, gift annuities, beneficiary designations, retained life estates)
Assess organizational capacity to administer each
Select the vehicles to offer based on donor base and complexity
Define the administration process for each selected vehicle

steps.description: Create marketing materials to promote planned giving.

outputs.name: marketing-materials
outputs.desc: Brochures, web pages, and email content

outputs.name: advisor-toolkit
outputs.desc: Materials for donors' financial and legal advisors

process: Write plain-language descriptions of each giving vehicle
Create print and digital marketing materials
Develop sample bequest language for wills
Build a toolkit for donors to share with their advisors

steps.description: Identify and cultivate planned giving prospects from the donor base.

inputs.name: donor-database
inputs.desc: Current donor records with giving history

process: Screen the donor base for planned giving indicators (age, loyalty, giving level, engagement)
Rank prospects by likelihood and capacity
Design a cultivation strategy for each prospect tier
Schedule personal outreach for top prospects

steps.description: Track the planned giving pipeline and produce the program plan.

outputs.name: pipeline-report
outputs.desc: Status of each prospect in the pipeline

process: Track each prospect through cultivation stages (awareness, interest, commitment, documented)
Record confirmed expectancies and their estimated values
Report on pipeline status and matured gifts
Compile the program plan with goals, strategies, and metrics

description: Execute a fundraising event from concept through logistics to post-event follow-up.

steps.description: Define the event concept, format, and budget.

inputs.name: event-type-preference
inputs.desc: Gala, auction, walk-a-thon, or other format

process: Select the event format based on audience and fundraising goal
Set the date and define the theme
Build the expense budget (venue, catering, entertainment, printing, AV)
Set the revenue budget (tickets, sponsorships, auction, fund-a-need)

steps.description: Secure the venue and vendors for the event.
process: Research and visit venue options
Request proposals from vendors
Negotiate contracts within budget
Confirm all bookings with signed agreements

steps.description: Sell tickets and sponsorships to meet the revenue target.

outputs.name: sponsorship-commitments
outputs.desc: Confirmed sponsors with levels and benefits

process: Design sponsorship levels with benefits at each tier
Solicit sponsors starting with past supporters and major donors
Open ticket sales and promote through all channels
Track sales against targets and adjust promotion as needed

steps.description: Manage event logistics on the day of the event.

outputs.name: event-execution-log
outputs.desc: Timeline of the event as executed

process: Run the setup with vendors per the timeline
Manage registration and guest check-in
Execute the program (speeches, auction, fund-a-need)
Collect donations and process payments on site

steps.description: Send follow-up communications and produce the event report.

outputs.name: event-fundraiser-report
outputs.desc: Final revenue, expenses, and net proceeds

process: Send thank-you emails within 48 hours
Mail tax receipts for donations and auction purchases
Calculate net proceeds (revenue minus expenses)
Produce the event report with lessons for next year

description: Evaluate a nonprofit program from question definition through data collection to recommendations.

steps.description: Define the evaluation questions and scope.

inputs.name: program-description
inputs.desc: Description of the program to evaluate

inputs.name: evaluation-purpose
inputs.desc: Why the evaluation is being conducted (funder requirement, improvement, accountability)

outputs.name: evaluation-questions
outputs.desc: Specific questions the evaluation will answer

process: Identify stakeholders and their information needs
Draft evaluation questions tied to program goals
Define the scope (which sites, time period, components)
Prioritize questions by importance and feasibility

steps.description: Select the evaluation methodology and design.

outputs.name: data-collection-instruments
outputs.desc: Surveys, interview guides, and observation protocols

process: Select the evaluation type (formative, summative, developmental, empowerment)
Choose the design (pre-post, comparison group, case study, mixed methods)
Develop data collection instruments
Plan the sampling strategy and timeline

steps.description: Collect data from participants, staff, and program records.

outputs.name: collection-log
outputs.desc: Record of data collection activities and response rates

process: Administer surveys to participants and stakeholders
Conduct interviews and focus groups
Review program records and administrative data
Document response rates and any collection issues

steps.description: Analyze the data and identify key findings.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.desc: Key findings organized by evaluation question

outputs.name: data-visualizations
outputs.desc: Charts and tables supporting the findings

process: Analyze quantitative data (descriptive statistics, comparisons, trends)
Analyze qualitative data (coding, theme identification)
Triangulate findings across data sources
Create visualizations for key findings

steps.description: Write the evaluation report with recommendations.
process: Write the executive summary with headline findings
Present findings by evaluation question with supporting evidence
Develop actionable recommendations prioritized by impact and feasibility
Include a section on limitations and suggestions for future evaluation
